newsitem.title: USA: Alexander & Alexander says IRS withdraws proposal.
newsitem.headline: Alexander & Alexander says IRS withdraws proposal.

text.p: Alexander & Alexander Services Inc said Tuesday that the U.S. Internal Revenue Service IRS withdrew a proposal to increase the company's 1991 taxable income, eliminating a potential tax liability of more than $50 million.

As a result of the IRS decision, Alexander & Alexander said its Series B convertible preferred stock purchase agreement has been amended and it will increase shareholder equity by $10 million. The company added that it intends to increase equity by reclassifying proceeds from the issuance of the Series B stock.
